'''Graich''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3641 BBY]] he was stationed at the [[Dorn Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and relayed to an arriving Imperial hero a message from [[Khun Tazith]]. Graich was enthusiastic about the famed [[Bane Brigade]] resurfacing to wipe the Republic from Hoth, unaware that it was in fact a ruse by Tazith designed to raise Imperial morale while plummeting the Republic's.
